rule: Accommodation managers or their agents see to it that foreign guests, including other EU nationals, personally complete and sign registration forms.
source: Convention implementing the Schengen Agreement, art. 45
key_sentence: personally complete and sign registration forms and confirm

rule: Accompanying spouses, accompanying minors and members of travel groups are exempt from completing and signing.
source: Convention implementing the Schengen Agreement, art. 45
key_sentence: spouses or accompanying minors or members of travel groups

rule: The guest confirms identity by producing a valid identity document; the text does not ask for a copy.
source: Convention implementing the Schengen Agreement, art. 45
key_sentence: their identity by producing a valid identity document

rule: Completed forms are kept for the competent authorities or forwarded to them where they deem it necessary, unless national law provides otherwise; no retention period is set.
source: Convention implementing the Schengen Agreement, art. 45
key_sentence: the completed registration forms will be kept for the competent

rule: The duty extends to persons staying in any commercially rented accommodation, such as tents, caravans and boats.
source: Convention implementing the Schengen Agreement, art. 45
key_sentence: any commercially rented accommodation, in

rule: Processing needed to comply with a legal obligation of the controller is lawful.
key_sentence: processing is necessary for compliance with a legal obligation to which the controller is subject

rule: Data minimisation: personal data must be limited to what is necessary for the purpose.
key_sentence: adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary in relation to the purposes for which they are processed

rule: Storage limitation: personal data are kept no longer than necessary.
key_sentence: for no longer than is necessary

rule: Member States may keep or introduce more specific provisions for processing under a legal obligation, so the exact data list and retention are national.
key_sentence: Member States may maintain or introduce more specific provisions to adapt the application of the rules

rule: Copying ID cards is generally not an appropriate way to authenticate; an indirect pointer only, since no EDPB guidance on hotel check-in was found.
source: EDPB Guidelines 01/2022 on the right of access, v2.1, para. 75 (about authenticating access requests, not check-in)
key_sentence: it should generally not be considered an appropriate way of authentication

rule: Hotels and similar accommodation are outside the short-term rental data rules; hostels and camping grounds are excluded the same way.
key_sentence: hotels and similar accommodation

rule: The regulation has applied since 20 May 2026.
key_sentence: It shall apply from 20 May 2026

rule: A host offering through an online platform must declare whether the unit is subject to registration and give the registration number if so.
key_sentence: provide the registration number

rule: An electronic signature cannot be denied legal effect or admissibility as evidence only because it is electronic.
key_sentence: shall not be denied legal effect and admissibility as evidence in legal proceedings solely on the grounds that it is in an electronic form

rule: A qualified electronic signature has the legal effect of a handwritten one.
key_sentence: A qualified electronic signature shall have the equivalent legal effect of a handwritten signature.

rule: Form requirements for documents are national; eIDAS does not affect them.
key_sentence: does not affect Union or national law related to the conclusion and validity of contracts

rule: RD 933/2021 applies to anyone who provides lodging for a price, professionally or not, including hotels, hostels, campsites, rural tourism and tourist apartments.
key_sentence: Se incluyen dentro de este concepto los hoteles, hostales, pensiones, casas de huéspedes, establecimientos de turismo rural o análogos.

rule: Campsites, motorhome parking areas, apartments and similar tourist lodging are covered regardless of ownership.
key_sentence: Las realizadas por campings y zonas de estacionamiento de autocaravanas, cualquiera que sea su titularidad o régimen de uso

rule: Every guest over 14 must sign the parte de entrada; data of children under 14 are supplied by the accompanying adult.
key_sentence: deberán ser firmados por toda persona mayor de catorce años que haga uso de los mismos

rule: The establishment supplies the parte and is responsible that the data match the identity documents shown by the guest.
key_sentence: serán responsables de la exactitud de los datos que se hagan constar en ellos

rule: The register is kept electronically and holds the Annex I data.
key_sentence: Los sujetos obligados habrán de llevar un registro informático en el que consten los datos que se relacionan en los anexos I y II

rule: Register data must be retained for three years from the end of the service.
key_sentence: deberán conservarse durante un plazo de tres años a contar desde la finalización del servicio o prestación contratada

rule: Non-professional hosts are exempt from the registry and retention duties but still owe the communication.
key_sentence: quedan exceptuados de las obligaciones de registro documental y conservación de datos previstos en este artículo

rule: Guest and contract data must be transmitted to the authorities immediately and in any case within 24 hours of the booking/contract (or cancellation) and of the start of service (a separate act from the signed parte).
key_sentence: en todo caso en un plazo no superior a 24 horas

rule: Professional operators communicate by telematic procedure; only non-professional hosts may use non-telematic means.
key_sentence: Las comunicaciones previstas en este artículo se realizarán por procedimientos telemáticos.

rule: Annex I (professional) fixes the closed list of guest data: name, two surnames, sex, ID number, support number, document type, nationality, birth date, residence, phones, email, number of travellers, kinship of minors.
key_sentence: Relación de parentesco entre los viajeros (en el caso de que alguno sea menor de edad).

rule: Annex I transaction block includes contract reference, date and signatures, check-in/out date and time, and payment data.
key_sentence: Fecha de y hora de entrada.

rule: Missing registers or omitted communications are serious infractions; irregular entries or late communications are minor infractions.
key_sentence: La realización de las comunicaciones obligatorias fuera del plazo establecido.

rule: Fine ranges: serious 601 to 30,000 EUR; minor 100 to 600 EUR.
key_sentence: las graves, con multa de 601 a 30.000 euros, y las leves, con multa de 100 a 600 euros

rule: Interior accepts collecting guest data by any verifiable system, including without physical presence, if data protection compliant (FAQ updated 10/08/2026).
source: Ministerio del Interior, Preguntas frecuentes hospedajes y alquiler de vehículos
key_sentence: incluso sin que sea necesaria su presencia física

rule: A Supreme Court judgment annulled the registro único procedure and the obligation to obtain a state registration number to list short lets on platforms; the rest of RD 1312/2024 stands.
key_sentence: Anular los preceptos del Real Decreto impugnado referidos al procedimiento de registro único de arrendamientos

rule: Art. 8 (Registro único de arrendamientos) of RD 1312/2024 is annulled.
key_sentence: Se anula por Sentencia del TS de 19 de mayo de 2026

rule: The Ventanilla Única Digital de Arrendamientos (Reg. 2024/1028 gateway) remains in force under RD 1312/2024 art. 7.
key_sentence: se crea la Ventanilla Única Digital de Arrendamientos de España

rule: Sanctions for platforms failing the data supply and exchange duties of Reg. 2024/1028 are set by Title V introduced by RDL 29/2026 (convalidated 12 Nov 2026); they target platforms, not hosts.
key_sentence: El incumplimiento por las plataformas en línea de alquiler de corta duración de las obligaciones de suministro e intercambio de datos vinculadas a la Ventanilla Única Digital de Arrendamientos

rule: Andalucía: a document 'a modo de contrato' is handed to each user on reception, signed by the user, kept one year, and holds operator, registry code, number of occupants, dates and total price.
key_sentence: le será entregado un documento, a modo de contrato

rule: Canarias vacation homes: if the booking was not already in writing, both parties sign before occupation a document with hours, maximum occupants and prices incl. IGIC, in Spanish and English (applicability after Ley 6/2025 not checked).
key_sentence: será preceptivo que ambas partes firmen un documento
